artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let the Motzkin numbers be defined by
$$M_n=\sum_{k=0}^{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}\binom{n}{2k}\frac{1}{k+1}\binom{2k}{k}\qquad(n=0,1,2,\dots),$$
and let the central trinomial coefficients $T_n$ be defined as the constant term in the expansion of $(1+x+x^{-1})^n$, equivalently
$$T_n=\sum_{k=0}^{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}\binom{n}{2k}\binom{2k}{k}.$$
Let $H_k=\sum_{j=1}^{k}\frac{1}{j}$ denote the $k$-th harmonic number (with $H_0=0$). For an odd prime $p$, let $\left(\frac{p}{3}\right)$ denote the Legendre symbol of $p$ modulo $3$.

Prove or disprove that for every prime $p>3$ the following four congruences hold in $\mathbb{Z}_p$:
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1} M_k^{2}\;\equiv\;(2-6p)\left(\frac{p}{3}\right)\pmod{p^2},$$
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1} k\,M_k^{2}\;\equiv\;(9p-1)\left(\frac{p}{3}\right)\pmod{p^2},$$
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1} T_k M_k\;\equiv\;4\left(\frac{p}{3}\right)+p\!\left(1-9\!\left(\frac{p}{3}\right)\right)\pmod{p^2},$$
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1} \frac{T_k H_k}{3^k}\;\equiv\;3+\left(\frac{p}{3}\right)^{\!2}-p\!\left(1+\left(\frac{p}{3}\right)\right)\pmod{p^2}.$$
